cohort: Eighty-five parturients undergoing cesarean delivery were analyzed.
finding: Parturients with a preoperatively prolonged QTc (>=440 ms) had a significantly lower incidence of spinal hypotension (40.5% vs 86.0%) and required less phenylephrine during cesarean delivery.
followup_time: Data was analyzed until delivery and for 30 minutes post-anesthesia for vasopressor requirements.
